en: Heating an aerosol spray can increases the gas pressure inside, which can cause the metal container to explode dangerously.
Pouring muddy water through a clean cloth filter removes large solid particles, making the liquid safer to boil and drink.
Mixing bleach with vinegar creates a toxic chlorine gas that can severely damage your lungs and eyes.
Wooden spoon handles stay cool during cooking because wood is a thermal insulator that does not conduct heat well.
Eating food from a heavily rusted iron can is unsafe because rust is a new chemical compound that can cause illness.
Crushing a solid medicine tablet and dissolving it in water creates a solution that your stomach can absorb faster.
Water expands when it freezes into solid ice, which can cause closed glass bottles to crack and shatter in the freezer.
You must shake a liquid antibiotic suspension before drinking it because the solid medicine particles settle at the bottom over time.
Burning plastic releases toxic chemical gases into the air, so you should never burn trash in an open fire.
Life jackets help you float in water because the foam material is less dense than water and provides buoyancy.
Sweating cools your body down because the liquid sweat absorbs heat from your skin to evaporate into a gas.
Soap molecules bind to both water and oil, allowing you to wash away greasy dirt and germs from your hands.
